text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: ...I lost.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't... push through to the end...
...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Waaaahaaaaaaaaahhh...!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*, it's so frustrating...!
Uuu...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Vivlos-chan...! Viiiivloooos!!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
"Vivlos.........!
Nggghhhhh~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Vivlos-chan is the one who's most frustrated.
I shouldn't cry, but... uuuuugh!

text_block_list.name: Father & Mother
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAHH!
WAHHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey everyone,
shall we give her a round of applause?"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: When times are tough...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Because someone's feelings are something to be happy about.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Besides, that girl... was strong.
Truly...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Vivlos.
Thank you—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Vivlos suffered defeat. Yet she ran the Triple Tiara route with everything she had. For her sake—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa~, what a party!
Sooo high-class celebrity!!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, right?
It's a present from us!
Enjoy it to your heart's content!
choice_data_list: (W-Wow, this is on a whole other scale...!)

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please make sure you enjoy yourself too.
The food at this hotel
is absolutely delicious!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey... to think you prepared something
this amazing for me...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"...Even though I lost.
I'm sorry we couldn't make this a victory celebration."

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text: No matter what place you finished in, it doesn't change the fact that you gave it your all and ran through the Tiara route.

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Our pride in you... in everyone...
that feeling will never ever change!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Great work out there again, Vivlos.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big sis...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I'm proud of you too.
Thank you for working so hard!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Nihehe♪
I got to see that look on your face, so... totally worth it!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Mother
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong?
Mommy's smiling too~. Tee-hee♪

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text:
Papa, you too!
Grrriiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sisters' Father
text_block_list.text: Come on, Trainer, you too!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: ...*stare*

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not doing it...!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Hahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“――Ahaha...!
Alright, what should we check out next!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Look, Vivlos!
It's so beautiful—"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Did it show?
Yeah... it's so much fun—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The party ended, and at Vivlos's request,
we headed back to the academy ahead of the others.
choice_data_list: Are you sure it was okay not to go with everyone?
Was it really okay not to be with everyone?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
Because I wanted to talk to you, Trainy!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Yup.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I did my very best!
Now I can move forward.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
—Now I can aim for Dubai
with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, from here on... we'll be aiming for
her other dream: racing in Dubai.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
I realized something today.
I really, truly want to go to Dubai!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: What should we start with?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I need info on how Vivlos might perform
in Dubai. To do that, I have to pick a domestic race
under similar conditions.
choice_data_list: I'd like to aim for the "Nakayama Kinen".

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Oh! 
I was just thinking that too!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: "There are Umamusume who got great results at the Nakayama Kinen and went on to win in Dubai, after all."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe,
I'm the Dubai Master, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"From the Nakayama Kinen to Dubai...
It's decided!♪"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Go to Dubai, and then...! I'm gonna become a super-celeb~~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, aiming for the races in Dubai...
we first take on the prep race, the Nakayama Kinen!
